panels.description: The barrier crushes Alex's wrist guard in the track. Keep metal, guard and hand separated safely; leave upper space for impact lettering.
A service shutter closes behind Lina while a clerk forces her through the narrowing opening. Keep Lina's face and hands clear; leave upper shutter space.
Ada strikes the barrier glass from the far side while Alex is trapped on the opposite side. Keep both figures separated by the clear barrier and leave upper space.
A white-and-amber node flashes the conditional convenor and pending collaborator status. Keep the display unobstructed.
